studyQueue.title: The AI Iceberg Index: Sector & Role Exposure Across North America
studyQueue.question: How much of the wage economy is exposed to AI beneath the visible tech surface (MIT / Oak Ridge Project Iceberg: 2.2% visible vs. 11.7% submerged), how do occupational roles break down inside the 12 major NAICS industries, and how does exposure shift across regional economies?
studyQueue.dataset: MIT / ORNL Project Iceberg (151M workers, 923 occupations, 32k skills) + BLS OES / StatCan NAICS sector matrices
studyQueue.notes: First end-to-end Workbench test study: interactive regional map, 12-industry x 6-role matrix, and compiled LaTeX PDF.

studyQueue.title: 2026 Alberta Referendum: All 10 Ballot Questions & Demographic Vote Anatomy
studyQueue.question: Why did Alberta voters pass all 5 non-constitutional immigration/voter-ID questions, reject all 4 constitutional amendments, and vote 74.95% to 25.05% to remain in Canada — and how did age, region, party coalition, and identity attachment divide the vote?
studyQueue.dataset: Elections Alberta Oct 19, 2026 count (>2.07M ballots) + Abacus Data (n=1,021) + Research Co. exit & pre-vote polls (n=811, n=601)
studyQueue.notes: Second Workbench study: compares ballot categories, regional/age/party splits, and voter motives with a compiled LaTeX PDF.

studyQueue.title: First to Four Basketball — Leverage & Run-Distribution Study
studyQueue.question: Which challenge wins carry the highest conditional series-clinch swing, and how do streak lengths compare with a stationary coin-flip baseline?
studyQueue.dataset: records/basketball/series.json (13 series, 73 rounds) + upcoming Series 14+ logs
studyQueue.notes: Queued for the JimmyHighRoller-style deep dive once the next series batch is logged.

studyQueue.title: Primer-Style Evolutionary & Market Agent Simulations
studyQueue.question: How do replicator dynamics and spatial resource limits shift cooperative vs. hawkish equilibria in small populations?
studyQueue.dataset: Synthetic agent trajectories + phase_lab simulation runner
studyQueue.notes: Planned interactive simulation branch with downloadable parameter seeds.

Count the deficit in chalk dust, never count what it cost.

Half the room wants a megaphone, half wants a way.

schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS study_queue (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    question TEXT NOT NULL,
    dataset TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('published', 'in-progress', 'queued')),
    study_route TEXT,
    paper_route TEXT,
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wishlist_todos (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')),
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('done', 'in-progress', 'planned')),
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rap_lyrics (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    bucket TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    bars TEXT NOT NULL,
    theme_cue TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'recorded', 'published'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_notes (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('Journal', 'Podcast', 'Study Memo', 'Freestyle')),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (duration_seconds >= 0),
    audio_format TEXT NOT NULL,
    transcript TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('processed', 'queued'))
);
